messages:
maria: Deploybot just flagged a canary p95 latency regression on v3.6.1 (US-W). Seeing ~3x spike, traffic at 10% slice. Can we decide rollback vs pin? @oncall please weigh in.
john: ugh. can we pin traffic to v3.6.0 and run a targeted rollback for the canary slice? keeps majority live.
li: agree with pin + targeted rollback if SLOs are broken. what's the blast radius? any dedicated customers on that routing?
ash: only small internal sandbox customers on that slice, no enterprise traffic. i can run the rollback once we confirm.
deploybot: [ALERT] Canary p95 latency crossed threshold (alert_id: cb-7782). Auto-revert suppressed (manual override window). Metrics: p95=980ms target=300ms.
sre-bot: @maria recommend pinning versions and scaling down batch sizes temporarily per rollback playbook. See runbook step 3.
ash: putting this as action: 1) pin v3.6.0 for canary route, 2) trigger rollback-script --region=us-west --slice=canary, 3) update release notes + customer comms. ready to execute on +1.
maria: +1 to pin then rollback. john can you draft the commit to release-notes and a short CS blurb for Erin?
john: on it. blurb: "We observed increased generation latency for a small subset of canary traffic on v3.6.1 and are rolling back the canary to v3.6.0 while we investigate. No customer data impacted. We'll follow up with root cause." OK?
erin-cs: that's fine. I'll prep a short status email to impacted customers and CS slack channel. Send me exact timestamps and rollout window after execute. :thumbsup:
nash: executing now. command: ```./rollback-script --to-version=v3.6.0 --region=us-west --slice=canary --dry-run=false``` Starting at 18:42 UTC.
deploybot: [ACTION] Rollback started by nash at 4777778905. Progress: 25% -> 60% -> 100%.
nash: rollback finished. canary p95 back to ~290ms. monitoring for 15m.
li: checking dashboards: looks stable. good call.
maria: great. john, update release notes with the rollback entry and tag the commit with #rollback-v3.6.1. erin, please post the customer note once you have the window/time.
john: note committed: "canary rollback to v3.6.0 due to p95 regression; investigating kvcache eviction interaction." pushed.
erin-cs: emailed impacted customers and posted to #customer-ops. included link to status doc.
sre-bot: Monitoring check completed: 15m green for p95 and error budget unaffected. Closing incident. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all. follow-up: open a postmortem ticket and @research to look at kvcache heuristics. Closing thread.
